original_query: How many days off do people get for National Day?

summaries.found_via_query: National Day days off policy for employees in most countries
summaries.summary: The slide titled 'China Outbound: When?' lists public holidays in China with corresponding days off. It specifically mentions National Day as occurring from 1-3 October, with a standard of 3 days off, which can be extended to 1 week.
key_facts: National Day in China is from 1-3 October
visible_text: New Year's day 1 January (one day off)
Spring Festival (Chinese New Year) Varies according to lunar calendar (3 days off extended to 1 or 2 weeks)
Tomb Sweeping Festival 5 April (one day off)
Dragon Boat Festival June, varies according to lunar calendar (one day off)
Mid-Autumn Festival September, lunar calendar (one day off)
National Day 1 - 3 October (3 days off extended to 1 week)
